controls: same-gain frozen mate receives exact feedback; all references share learned motor; updating arms may collect different on-policy failures

encoder.prior: contrastive sentence training includes QA and code pairs; contamination unknown
encoder.sentence_pooling: attention-mask mean including special tokens; L2 normalization
encoder.span_pooling: mean overlapping complete non-special subtokens; no normalization
encoder.truncation: reject; caller must declare any chunking

feedback_contract: affine primary, raw candidate fallback after STOP; actual FAIL/teacher PASS pairs only; reserved 150-offer allocation in both arms; projection and learned basis are conventional global training arithmetic
kind: public development; unchanged-policy robustness stream: wording
resource_scope: wall time includes child waits; memory covers parent/evaluator/ledger, excluding child memory
retained_source_policy: pretrained frozen MiniLM plus external raw documents, candidate vectors, storage ancestry and immutable correction ledger

synapse_checkpoint.scope: trained synapses; ordered fixtures and receipts reconstruct storage and lineage

teaching_exposure: same linked sixteen teaching requests and 48 encounters; three fresh streams frozen before outputs; no oracle weights
